title: fix(app-shell): nav page picker offers a draft page only when its draft body can be a nav target
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8PBqR3JqcpQdxvP362pdfwm)_
Fixes #26743

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:Studio Interfaces 导航项的「页面」选择器不再列出草稿态的记录页;草稿页按其草稿正文的 `type` 判定,与已发布页同一规则(绑定对象的草稿动作同理)。
- 为什么改:`_drafts` 行只带元数据类型 `page`,不带页面自身的 `type`,原代码对草稿行一律放行,选中草稿记录页、随应用发布后导航项打不开。
- 风险与回滚:只改 Studio 选择器的候选列表;每个仅草稿的页面/动作多一次草稿读取;读不到正文时仍列出(与无 `type` 的已发布行一致)。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`StudioDesignSurface.tsx` 的 `isDraftNavTarget` 与 `usePackageNavTargets` 中草稿循环;再看新测试 `StudioDesignSurface.navPageDrafts-26743.test.tsx`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.navPageDrafts-26743.test.tsx`,预期 6 个测试全过。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- `usePackageNavTargets` (Interfaces nav item inspector's target picker): a draft-only row of a type whose `isNavTargetRow` verdict reads a body key (`page`: the body's `type`; `action`: `objectName`) is now judged on its draft body, read with `client.getDraft` and unwrapped by `extractDraftBody`, the one draft-envelope reader. A draft record page is no longer offered; a draft static page still is.
- A body that cannot be read (no draft served, a failed read) keeps the row, as a published row with no `type` is kept: only a confirmed non-target is dropped. Other target types (`dashboard`, `report`, `doc`) read no body.
- In-place fix named here: the same draft loop also offered a draft action bound to an object, which the nav cannot run (it runs global actions only). Same defect class, same line, same gate families; covered by one test.

## Why

The `_drafts` header (`ListDraftsResponseSchema`) carries the metadata type name and the draft's `label`, never the body's own `type`, so the old loop could not filter and added every draft-only row. Fixed client-side with the existing draft read; no spec or server change.

## Tests

New `StudioDesignSurface.navPageDrafts-26743.test.tsx` (6 tests): a draft record page is not offered; a draft static page is offered; a published record page is still not offered; CONTROL an unreadable draft body is still offered; a draft object-bound action is not offered, a draft global action is; only body-keyed types read drafts, published rows are never re-read.

<details><summary>Ablation (commit ca23ec41)</summary>

`node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` replaced the anchor `if (verdicts[i]) byName.set(row.name, row);` with an always-true condition: anchor 1 -> 0, blob 8a30d22bfe30 -> e63569e6a119. Result: `a draft record page is not offered` and `a draft action bound to an object is not offered, a draft global action is` failed (2 failed, 4 passed). Restored: blob == HEAD (8a30d22bfe30), `git diff HEAD` empty. No dist leg: the test imports the component by relative path.
</details>

## Verification

All local readings at head `ca23ec41` (base `aa00362f`).

<details><summary>Local gates</summary>

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`: 24 derived families, all run, every one exit 0; `--ran` reconciliation: 24 derived, 24 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.
- `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs` exit 0 (and `--self-test` exit 0).
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell run type-check` exit 0.
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/ packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/`: Test Files 429 passed, Tests 4289 passed, 1 skipped.
- `pnpm --dir ui run check:new-line-citations`: 0 new citations, exit 0.
- `node scripts/check-nul-bytes.mjs` exit 0.
</details>

Changeset: none. `@object-ui/app-shell` is `private: true`, so nothing publishes; `skip-changeset` is declared with this PR.

## Acceptance notes

- Each draft-only page or action costs one `?state=draft` read when the picker opens; `getDraft` asks the shared `_drafts` ledger read first, so no extra ledger request is sent.
